prompts.title: OPA Gatekeeper vs Kyverno?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** **Gatekeeper** uses **Rego**; **Kyverno** uses **Kubernetes YAML** policies-both validate/mutate at admission. Pick by team skill and policy complexity.

prompts.title: Pod compromised—what limits damage?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** **NetworkPolicy** egress deny, **non-root** + **read-only rootfs**, **minimal SA RBAC**, **no hostPath**, **metadata service** not reachable from user-controlled fetchers, **secrets** not in env (prefer CSI with rotation).
